svg.title: A real dated slide enters the invented forum
svg.desc: Place the real dated slide inside the invented room's screen with readable citation. Unidentifiable speaker silhouettes belong to the displayed artifact, not the forum participants. Keep the paper-fragment perimeter and four empty wall bays visible as invented staging, with no official chamber insignia.
